caption:
does ice water close your pores?

No. Cold can make skin feel tighter for a moment, but a pore has no muscle to open or shut. Look at your nose before and after a cold splash: the pores look the same.

What actually sets pore size: how much oil your skin makes, looser skin around the pore, and the size of the hair follicle inside. Acne, hormones and your routine can play a part too (Lee et al., Dermatologic Surgery, 2016 review).

That's also why steam doesn't really "open" them.

Skin Test #14/30 from a doctor in Seoul. Follow for #15: which wrinkle comes from your pillow?

General education only.
